question: Do the official freqtrade-strategies (unchanged source, original timeframe, ROI, stoploss, trailing and exit settings) make money (a) on their home market and (b) on KR stocks with KR costs?
engine: freqtrade 2026.10, WSL Ubuntu Python 3.12.3 venv, ccxt 4.5.92, TA-Lib 0.8.3
included: every IStrategy class outside lookahead_bias/ and futures/ except the exclusions below (52 classes, DoesNothingStrategy kept as a null control)

excluded.futures/: futures and short strategies; the account is long-only spot
excluded.Freqtrade_backtest_validation_freqtrade1: engine validation fixture, not a strategy

common.timeframe: taken from each strategy (not set in the config)

binance_home.data_download: 20250901-20261101 so startup candles exist before the window

kr_top10.mapping: map_kr_top10.json (10 largest traded values in the stored Toss 1m files, chosen before any backtest; borrowed Binance pair names, prices / 10000, volume unchanged)
kr_top10.fee_note: 0.015% fee each side + 0.20% sell tax = 0.23% round trip, split evenly per side
kr_top10.informative_pairs: strategies that request BTC/USDT or ETH/USDT informative data fail on this market until a market proxy is mapped; failures are recorded, not patched

recorded_per_run: market change % (average of the pairs over the window)

decision_rule.no_edge_claim: no strategy is called an edge from this sweep alone: 52 strategies x 2 markets are tested on one window each
decision_rule.multiple_testing: a per-strategy p-value below 0.05/52 = 0.00096 is required before calling a result unlikely by chance
decision_rule.advance_to_next_rung: KR stock-cost profit > 0 AND profit factor > 1.1 AND trades >= 30; advancing strategies are re-tested on a second window and on KODEX 200 before any paper use
decision_rule.comparison: each result is shown next to the market change of the same pairs and window; a strategy that is mostly in cash is not called better than holding unless its profit exceeds the market change

outputs: results/sweep_v1/<market>/<strategy>/ (freqtrade result zip + meta), results/sweep_v1/logs/, results/sweep_v1_summary.json
